meta.title: Forward auction: first bid
warnings: resolved: “The strategy-dependent live update showing the vendor's rank or the best price after submitting the bid” — vendor_bid types the price on the open portal and reports what the sheet and Submit did (attempt{vendor_bid} for a refusal)

steps.note: Open the already prepared live auction without creating or searching for another event.
Move to the separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live auction from Vendor A's event list and enter its pricing bid sheet.
Enter Vendor A's first quote of 100 and submit it.
Verify that the supplier portal accepted the bid and shows the round as Submitted.
